name: gpu_utilization
description: Read actual GPU busy utilization by hostname and optional numeric GPU index. Requires a verified gpu_metric mapping: pass it explicitly, or omit it only when the activation has a configured default. Explicit mapping overrides the default; metric label names are case-sensitive. Ready/authenticated does not verify this action's mapping. Missing mapping fails with gpu_metric_not_configured (HTTP 400). Only a successful query with no samples returns no_data; zero is an observed value. Discover mappings with dashboard_get/gpu_arena_describe and metrics_query; see package how-to-use.
